attrs.Help_string: What this block does: Will create eyes aim system. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetParent: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. EyesAmount: choose one option (for example: Two, One). CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4). Tip: start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need. Template parent examples: Spine_End_Jnt, Head_Jnt, L_Wrist_Jnt.
